business_rules.rule: It is necessary that WS-R is calculated as WS-A + WS-B.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The result (WS-R) is calculated as the a (WS-A) plus the b (WS-B).

business_rules.rule: If (WS-R >= 10), then 5 is added to WS-R.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If the result (WS-R) is at least 10, then 5 is added to the result.

business_rules.rule: If (WS-R >= 10), then WS-DSP-R is set to WS-R.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If the result (WS-R) is at least 10, then the displayed result (WS-DSP-R) is set to the result.

business_rules.rule: If (NOT (WS-R >= 10)), then 7 is subtracted from WS-R.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If not (the result (WS-R) is at least 10), then 7 is subtracted from the result.

business_rules.rule: If (NOT (WS-R >= 10)), then WS-DSP-R is set to WS-R.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If not (the result (WS-R) is at least 10), then the displayed result (WS-DSP-R) is set to the result.
